etymologies.etymologyHTML: From protect +‎ -ive.

quote.citation: 2004, Mickey Baskett, Fabulous Painted Furniture, page 13:
quote.text: Pour a solvent such as paint thinner, mineral spirits, or a liquid sandpaper product in a metal can or enamel bowl. Wear protective gloves.

definitions.definition: Wishing to protect; defensive of somebody or something.
